Overall correctness: correct  
Confidence: 0.88

No confirmed findings in the assigned patch.

- All 15 `CompactMap` fields are frozen before publication, either through `From<HashMap>` or explicit `freeze()`. Small-map borrowed-key lookup preserves equality semantics; larger maps retain their existing randomized `HashMap`.
- Call indices are captured in source/build order and remapped through the source-to-arena permutation for all three collections: `call_indices`, `incoming`, and `outgoing`. Published call access directly indexes the occurrence arena.
- Inspected LSP incoming/outgoing hierarchy routing and hierarchy-equivalence comparison use the new borrowed-call accessors consistently. No remaining consumers of the removed `target_for_site` or semantic entity `sites` API were found in source, tests, or benchmarks.
- Entry-qualified identities, generations, rename lookups, and provenance retain their existing underlying values and validation paths.

Limits: static review only; no builds, tests, benchmarks, or other checks were run. This review establishes no candidate performance improvement or CI-policy acceptance.
